why: A September 2025 arXiv paper (2509.15456) claims a linear recoloring diameter bound for degenerate chordal graphs and bounded treewidth graphs, settling Cereceda's conjecture (with a stronger linear bound than the conjectured quadratic) for these restricted graph classes.
